Apple's list price for the M4 MacBook Air in the US is $999 for the 13-inch and $1,199 for the 15-inch, according to Macworld. The 13-inch's $999 price returned after the M3 generation had been priced at $1,099, and the 15-inch dropped $100 from the M3 model's price. These figures come from launch-era coverage, so I couldn't confirm from these results what Apple's online store shows today.

Retailers have discounted the laptop repeatedly. AppleInsider reported Amazon's year-end sale at $749.99 for the base 13-inch model with 16GB RAM and 256GB storage. 3DTested reported a similar $749 Amazon price as an all-time low. Deal prices change often, so check current listings before buying.

I couldn't get the live price from Apple's store, because my fetch of apple.com was blocked. The figures below come from launch-era coverage, not today's store page.

- **13-inch M4 MacBook Air:** $999 list price.
- **15-inch M4 MacBook Air:** $1,199 list price.

Retailers have often sold it for less. Amazon had the base 13-inch (16GB RAM, 256GB storage) at about $749 in a year-end sale. Apple's own prices may also have changed since launch. It's now October 2026, and a newer MacBook Air generation may have replaced the M4 as the one Apple lists. Apple's MacBook Air page (apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air) will show what it charges now.
